content: Elagolix is a weak-to-moderate inducer of the hepatic enzyme CYP3A4. When co-administered with drugs that are substrates of CYP3A4, careful monitoring of these substrates is recommended. If necessary, consider increasing the dose of the CYP3A4 substrate to maintain therapeutic efficacy. Elagolix increases the levels or effects of lansoprazole by inhibiting the hepatic enzyme CYP2C19 metabolism. Close monitoring is advised, and therapy modifications may be required. Elagolix also decreases lansoprazole levels by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Adjust therapy and monitor closely. Elagolix increases the levels or effects of lapatinib by inhibiting the P-glycoprotein (MDR1) efflux transporter. Conversely, it decreases lapatinib levels by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Therapy adjustments and close monitoring are necessary. Elagolix decreases the levels of larotrectinib by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Therapy modifications and close monitoring are recommended. Larotrectinib may increase the levels or effects of elagolix by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism, though the clinical significance is uncertain. Close monitoring is advised. Elagolix increases the levels or effects of ledipasvir/sofosbuvir by inhibiting the P-glycoprotein (MDR1) efflux transporter. Caution is advised, and close monitoring is necessary. Elagolix decreases the levels or effects of lefamulin by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Co-administration with strong or moderate CYP3A4 inducers should be avoided unless the benefits outweigh the risks. Therapy adjustments and monitoring for reduced efficacy are recommended. Elagolix decreases the levels or effects of lemborexant by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid co-administration or use an alternative drug. Lenacapavir increases the levels or effects of elagolix by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Caution is advised, and close monitoring is necessary. Lenacapavir also increases the levels or effects of norethindrone acetate by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor closely. Conversely, elagolix decreases the levels or effects of lenacapavir by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid co-administration or use an alternative drug. Elagolix decreases the levels or effects of leniolisib by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Leniolisib increases the levels or effects of elagolix through other mechanisms. Avoid co-administration or use an alternative drug. Leniolisib, as an OATP1B1 and OATP1B3 inhibitor, may increase systemic exposure to these substrates. Lenvatinib increases the levels or effects of elagolix through other mechanisms. Co-administration is contraindicated. Elagolix increases the levels or effects of lenvatinib by inhibiting the P-glycoprotein (MDR1) efflux transporter. Use caution and monitor closely. Elagolix decreases the levels or effects of levamlodipine by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor closely. There is no quantitative data on the effects of CYP3A4 inducers on amlodipine. Blood pressure should be closely monitored when amlodipine is co-administered with CYP3A4 inducers. Levoketoconazole increases the levels or effects of elagolix by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Therapy adjustments and close monitoring are recommended. Co-administration of elagolix 200 mg BID with strong CYP3A inhibitors for more than one month is not recommended. Limit the elagolix dose to 150 mg once daily and restrict CYP3A inhibitor use to six months if co-administered. Elagolix decreases the levels or effects of levomilnacipran by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Therapy adjustments and close monitoring are necessary. Elagolix decreases the levels or effects of levonorgestrel (oral, intrauterine, or transdermal) by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid co-administration or use an alternative drug. Estrogen-containing contraceptives are expected to reduce the efficacy of elagolix. The effects of progestin-only contraceptives on elagolix efficacy are unknown. Women should be advised to use nonhormonal contraceptives during elagolix treatment and for one week after discontinuation. Elagolix decreases the levels or effects of linagliptin by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Therapy adjustments and close monitoring are recommended. Elagolix increases linagliptin levels by inhibiting the P-glycoprotein (MDR1) efflux transporter. Monitor closely. Norethindrone acetate decreases the effects of liraglutide through pharmacodynamic antagonism. Use caution and monitor glycemic control in diabetic patients. Oral contraceptives may impair glucose tolerance and reduce the hypoglycemic effects of antidiabetics. Elagolix decreases the levels or effects of lomitapide by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Therapy adjustments and close monitoring are necessary. Elagolix decreases the levels or effects of lonafarnib by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Co-administration is contraindicated. Lonafarnib is a sensitive CYP3A4 substrate, and co-administration with strong or moderate CYP3A4 inducers is contraindicated. Elagolix increases the levels or effects of loperamide by inhibiting the P-glycoprotein (MDR1) efflux transporter. Use caution and monitor closely. Lopinavir increases the levels or effects of elagolix by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Therapy adjustments and close monitoring are recommended. Elagolix decreases lopinavir levels by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Therapy adjustments and close monitoring are necessary. Elagolix increases the levels or effects of loratadine by inhibiting the P-glycoprotein (MDR1) efflux transporter. Use caution and monitor closely. Lorlatinib decreases the levels or effects of elagolix by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Elagolix decreases lorlatinib levels by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Therapy adjustments and close monitoring are recommended. Elagolix decreases the levels or effects of losartan by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Therapy adjustments and close monitoring are necessary. Elagolix increases the levels or effects of lovastatin by inhibiting the P-glycoprotein (MDR1) efflux transporter. Elagolix decreases lovastatin levels by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Therapy adjustments and close monitoring are recommended. Lumacaftor/ivacaftor decreases the levels or effects of elagolix by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid co-administration or use an alternative drug. Lumacaftor/ivacaftor also decreases norethindrone acetate levels by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid co-administration unless the benefits outweigh the risks. Hormonal contraceptives are not reliable for effective birth control when co-administered. Elagolix decreases the levels or effects of lumateperone by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid co-administration or use an alternative drug. Elagolix decreases the levels or effects of lumefantrine by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Therapy adjustments and close monitoring are necessary. Elagolix decreases the levels or effects of lurasidone by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Therapy adjustments and close monitoring are recommended. Elagolix decreases the levels or effects of lurbinectedin by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid co-administration or use an alternative drug. Elagolix decreases the levels or effects of macimorelin by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Therapy adjustments and close monitoring are necessary. Elagolix decreases the levels or effects of macitentan by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Therapy adjustments and close monitoring are recommended. Elagolix increases the levels or effects of maraviroc by inhibiting the P-glycoprotein (MDR1) efflux transporter. Elagolix decreases maraviroc levels by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Therapy adjustments and close monitoring are necessary. Norethindrone acetate increases maraviroc levels by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor closely to avoid potential toxicity. Elagolix decreases the levels or effects of mavacamten by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Elagolix increases mavacamten levels by inhibiting CYP2C19 metabolism. Therapy adjustments and close monitoring are necessary. Mavacamten decreases norethindrone acetate levels by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid co-administration or use an alternative drug. Mavacamten may reduce systemic exposure to ethinyl estradiol and progestin, potentially leading to contraceptive failure or breakthrough bleeding. Advise patients to use non-CYP450-affected contraceptive methods or add nonhormonal contraception during and for four months after mavacamten administration. Elagolix increases the levels or effects of mavorixafor by inhibiting the P-glycoprotein (MDR1) efflux transporter. Therapy adjustments and close monitoring are recommended. Monitor mavorixafor levels if co-administered with P-gp inhibitors and reduce the dose if necessary. Elagolix decreases the levels or effects of medroxyprogesterone by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Therapy adjustments and close monitoring are necessary. Elagolix decreases the levels or effects of mefloquine by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Therapy adjustments and close monitoring are recommended. Elagolix decreases the levels or effects of mestranol by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Therapy adjustments and close monitoring are necessary. Mestranol decreases the effects of elagolix through pharmacodynamic antagonism. Avoid co-administration or use an alternative drug. Estrogen-containing contraceptives are expected to reduce elagolix efficacy. Women should use nonhormonal contraceptives during elagolix treatment and for one week after discontinuation. Elagolix decreases the levels or effects of metaxalone by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Therapy adjustments and close monitoring are recommended.
